proof_and_instruction_audit.assumptions: Dates, CU versus H/F, probabilities versus severity paths, interest, cash carry, claim ownership, priorities, collectibility, donor rights and limited liability are stated before their use. All panels are explicitly separate. No legal power is imported implicitly.
proof_and_instruction_audit.proofs: Solved finite-state incentive differences, exact-tail allocation across both dependence regimes, loss-law feasibility, piecewise monotone funding boundary including an attained jump, necessary/sufficient reserve, currency-carry feasibility with global grant lower bound and attaining plan, and private/public contribution necessity/sufficiency. Local duration is explicitly an approximation rather than an exact repricing theorem.
proof_and_instruction_audit.teaching_fit: The exam applies already taught monitoring, CFADS/allowance, finite tail, ALM, conditional probability, operational timing, branch reverse-stress, contingent benefits, currency/debt, incentive, resolution and governance methods. Specialist numerical tables or coding are not needed. Questions 3c and5c are evidence/rubric tasks with supported alternatives accepted.
proof_and_instruction_audit.scoring: Every determinate and open subpart has an explicit allocation adding to its printed score. No extra points are hidden in prose. Chapter evidence is traceable to13scored subparts, five equal20point domains,100overall.
proof_and_instruction_audit.critical_distinctions: Book capital is not cash; a chargeoff against allowance is not another income loss; a marginal distribution is not a joint law; positive future income is not current settlement; fit is not approved deployed use; scenario severity is not a frequency; promise/guarantee face is not cash; borrowing includes carry and later repayment; converted debt creates no cash; network loss is counted once; an unexecuted commitment is not an executed resource.

independent_computation.approach: The checker directly constructs the exam contracts with exact Fraction arithmetic. It imports no chapter implementation and reads no saved financial answers. It enumerates monitor default states, chronological borrower and allowance journals, individual-position joint loss events, common-event/residual route states, survivor-guarantor states and separately funded resolution wallets.
independent_computation.cross_methods: ES computed by descending exact tail allocation is independently compared to the minimum convex hinge objective over all loss kinks. Sovereign grant optimum uses all feasible pair intersections of two-variable linear inequalities, checked against a separate nonnegative lower-bound combination and a cash ledger with borrowing carry. Reverse funding uses affine branch endpoints and one-sided jump limits; sampled nearby severities supplement rather than replace the interval proof.
independent_computation.printed_results: 66 distinct data-calc anchors match rational results. The complete static service, pension and resolution solution tables were also read against their independently rebuilt schedules/state rows. Sign, currency, per-survivor amounts, resource recipients and exact prompt-to-solution correspondence were audited, not merely the100-point total.
